snippet.title: Forefeathers - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Bring forgotten memories back to light in Forefeathers, an atmospheric story adventure with puzzle elements.

Join the little penguin Bokki and his ghostly Grandma on a heartfelt journey as they work together to solve light-based puzzles and rekindle memories from her past.

Explore their story, uncover moments long forgotten and help Bokki illuminate the memories that connect him with his Grandma.

Wishlist Forefeathers now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4403560/Forefeathers/

#GamingUp #GamingUpShowcase #Forefeathers #PuzzleAdventure #IndieGames
